kizhiPorottaStory: Kizhi Porotta is cooked porotta stuffed with fried curry meat — usually beef or chicken — wrapped in banana leaf and tied into a bundle. The bundle is steamed, then grilled on a hot skillet with coconut oil, adding the aroma of banana leaf and coconut oil to the filling.
chattiChoruStory: Chatti Choru is a combination plate of rice, a variety of curries, and non-veg items, all served in a wide earthen pot.
aboutParagraph: Kayal has a long history of serving innovative and creative Indian cuisine. We try to reflect the essence of true India and an authentic approach to Indian cuisine from across the majestic sub-continent. We take great pride in serving a high-quality and authentic South Indian food menu to our customers.
